_README: Two levels: `vertical` is the parent (Retail, Travel, Banking, Telco),
`subvertical` is the child (Beauty, Fashion, Hotels, Insurance). A vertical
with no sub-verticals — Telco — simply repeats the name in both.
`template` selects the page model:
ecommerce  browse -> cart -> checkout -> purchase   (Retail)
booking    search -> select -> book -> confirmation (Travel, Banking, Telco)
Each entry gets its own subdomain: <key>.insiderdemo.com, so campaign rules
scope to a hostname and cannot collide.
To add one:
1. drop the catalog source at sources/<key>-1.json (see README for volume)
2. copy a block below, edit brand / theme / collections
3. python3 build.py <key>
4. add the subdomain in Netlify and to multiDomains in InOne

_README: Which Insider account a site talks to is decided by its SUBDOMAIN SUFFIX,
because a page carries one tag and a tag belongs to one account:
beauty.insiderdemo.com           -> salesdemo
beauty-sandbox.insiderdemo.com   -> partnersandbox
`default` applies when a subdomain carries no recognised suffix.
locale and currency must match the catalog these feeds load into.
en_GB keeps our products clear of the existing en_US catalog, which an
XML sync would otherwise replace. EUR because currency shows on every
product card and cart, while locale only appears in Catalog Manager.
